title: Predicting three orange orbs at 9:45 at Contact in the Desert

tellings.quote: And so I told the whole group and I were in advance. I said at 9:45 there'll be three orange orbs that appear underneath the clouds.

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a man who says UFOs appear around him and that NASA has studied him, describes a 2025 night at Contact in the Desert, a UFO gathering near Palm Springs, California. He says he told the whole group in advance that at 9:45 three orange balls of light would appear under the clouds. He tells it because, if it happened as he says, it would mean he can predict or call these lights.
